CustomField.description: When checked, PDF uses Named Credential DocEngine_Pdf → your HTTPS host (recommended: n8n + DocEngine node; or pdf-service). When unchecked, Salesforce Blob.toPdf (HTML→PDF).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Off = Salesforce HTML→PDF (no host). On = Named Credential DocEngine_Pdf → n8n DocEngine webhook (or pdf-service).
CustomField.label: Use External PDF
